states.name: ussr-higher-first
states.description: Turn 4's headline phase: the USSR chooses first. Fidel (2 ops) against the US's Panama Canal Returned (1 op) — the USSR's higher card resolves first.

states.name: us-higher-first
states.description: Headline phase: Fidel (2 ops) against Duck and Cover (3 ops) — the US's higher card resolves first.

states.name: tie-us-first
states.description: Headline phase: Fidel (2 ops) against Camp David Accords (2 ops) — a tie goes to the US.

states.name: defectors-cancels
states.description: Headline phase: the US holds Defectors, the USSR Fidel (Cuba US 2). If the US headlines Defectors the USSR's Fidel is cancelled and goes to the discard pile unplayed, whatever its Operations value.

states.name: man-in-earth-orbit
states.description: Headline phase with the USSR on space box 4 (Man in Earth Orbit) and the US on 0: the US must choose its headline first and the USSR, choosing second, sees it.

states.name: headline-defcon-loss
states.description: Headline phase at DEFCON 2. The USSR headlines Duck and Cover (3 ops: DEFCON -1) against the US's Panama Canal Returned (1 op): the USSR resolves first, DEFCON reaches 1, and the headliner — the phasing player — loses the game.

states.name: us-has-no-cards
states.description: Headline phase with the US holding no card at all: it has nothing to headline, so only the USSR chooses.

states.name: un-intervention-held
states.description: Headline phase with UN Intervention in the USSR's hand: it can't be headlined.

states.name: ops-card-headlined
states.description: Headline phase: the USSR headlines ABM Treaty (4 ops, DEFCON +1 then 'may conduct operations'): a headline is the event only, so the operations are not offered. Starts at DEFCON 3.

states.name: five-year-plan-spares-headline
states.description: Headline phase: the USSR's only card is Arab-Israeli War (2 ops), which it headlines; the US headlines Five Year Plan (3 ops) and resolves first. The headlined card is already played, so Five Year Plan has nothing to discard.

states.name: terrorism-spares-headline
states.description: Headline phase: the USSR headlines Terrorism (2 ops) and resolves first against the US's Panama Canal Returned (1 op), the US's only card. The headlined card is already played, so Terrorism has nothing to discard.

states.name: grain-sales-spares-headline
states.description: Headline phase: the US headlines Grain Sales to Soviets (2 ops) and, on a tie with Fidel, resolves first. The USSR's only card is its headlined Fidel, so there is nothing for Grain Sales to draw.
